reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: §13.5/p0116 only addresses Employee NDA/Invention Agreements and IP ownership, and p0094 is a confidentiality use restriction — none of the quoted text imposes a non-solicit, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant on Corio (our party).

Absence of any non-solicit matches the playbook's preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer'), so no redline or counterparty comment is expected or warranted; the rendered redline correctly leaves all three paragraphs unchanged and no comment is emitted.

The failing deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of applying non-solicit heuristics where no such clause exists; they do not indicate a defective proposal here.

Rationale appropriately flags residual risk that the incorporated Non-Disclosure Agreement (referenced in §14.10/p0133) could contain a non-solicit, with the correct fallback to apply if it does — a reasonable, non-actionable note rather than an unnecessary edit.
